purpose: Prevent historical-default or downstream-provisional state from being silently reinserted while advancing from the synchronized 1943-09-30 frontier.

Midway.detail: Japanese-held lean forward base from settled June 1942 MI; no current-authoritative recapture has been adjudicated by the 1943-09-30 cutoff.
Midway.anti_regression: Do not import the retained-provisional Sep-1943 US recapture before it is re-adjudicated on the current synchronized line.

New_Caledonia.detail: Japan controls the Noumea-Tontouta-La Foa-Bourail-Plaines des Gaiacs military corridor, ports/airfields/external traffic; nominal sovereignty/civil framework is Vichy French.
New_Caledonia.anti_regression: Do not collapse this to ordinary Allied ownership or simple Japanese annexation.

Efate.detail: June 8-9 Japanese operation was limited neutralization, not occupation; US strategic hold and recovery followed.

Hanzhong.detail: Five-Go Phase II took Hanzhong around 21 Jul; cleanup 22-23 Jul; no automatic Sichuan Phase III.

Maungdaw_Teknaf_Coxs_Bazar.detail: August exercise did not run through Japanese-held Maungdaw/Teknaf/Cox's; these were not Japanese-held.

survivors_or_rebuild: Wasp survives; June 1943 South Pacific fast-carrier central is Wasp
By late Aug/Sep multiple new Essex/Independence-class fast-carrier groups with F6F-class aircraft are a real combat factor
United_States.anti_regression: Do not restore historical named-carrier availability. New-build carrier power must be added on top of, not substituted for, branch losses.

Britain.state: Eastern Fleet modern-carrier depth materially below historical; Mediterranean/Home Fleet competition and maintenance margins remain binding.
Britain.anti_regression: Do not copy historical Eastern Fleet carrier reinforcement or offensive schedules without paying actual surviving decks, crews, escorts and global commitments.

other_survival_markers: Hiei and Kirishima are active in the June 1943 Efate settlement
Haruna is active in the May 1943 Aleutian rescue force
Shoho survived branch Coral Sea/MI ledger unless a later authoritative loss is adjudicated
unresolved_hulls: Shinshu Maru repair/readiness for Sep-Oct remains to close
Japan.anti_regression: Never apply historical sinking/death dates mechanically. Individual hull/commander fate must come from branch-authoritative settlement or remain unresolved.

japanese_combat_capability_guard.rule: Use branch TECH/OOB maturity at event date, not historical median capability and not future back-porting.
japanese_combat_capability_guard.event_specific_anchor: June 1943 Efate carrier air group explicitly includes branch A6M5-ish Zuisei-late Zero, limited D4Y bomber trials/D4Y1-C reconnaissance and B6N elements; do not back-port later Kinsei Zero/A7M.

sigint_comint_guard.US_constraint: Historical JN-25-like high-grade plaintext precision must not be silently restored; location/exact schedule/force composition are not normally reconstructed from high-grade ciphertext with short-strategic precision.
sigint_comint_guard.residual_channels: Traffic analysis, DF, low-grade/plaintext, reconnaissance, geography/logistics inference still exist; no information blackout.
sigint_comint_guard.Japanese_offense: Japanese COMINT can exploit low/mid-grade traffic, DF, plaintext and mistakes for probabilistic warning; not routine SIGABA reading.
sigint_comint_guard.operational_example: Operation Vengeance historical kill-chain fails; Yamamoto survives 1943-04-18.

china_guard.five_go_phase_II: 10 Jun start; Fengxian 19-20 Jun; Lueyang about 7 Jul; Hanzhong 21 Jul; cleanup 22-23 Jul.
china_guard.autumn_posture: Consolidation, repair, storage, airfield/road pressure and next-operation study; no automatic deep pursuit.
china_guard.india_transfer_constraint: Any engineering/transport/air support transfer to Burma must be charged against China consolidation rather than treated as free.

provisional_boundary.rule: Files listed as retained_provisional are evidence/reference only. Their dates, losses, ownership, OOB and outcomes do not overwrite the current synchronized line until re-adjudicated.
